name: Tree View
description: Nested folders and files with guide lines, keyboard navigation and selection.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the tree for assistive technology.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Whether rows can be selected, one or several at a time.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: Replace: a click selects only that row, and modifier keys add to it. Toggle: each click adds or removes.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: The ids of the selected rows (controlled). Use defaultSelectedKeys when uncontrolled.

props.name: expandedKeys
props.description: The ids of the open folders (controlled). Use defaultExpandedKeys when uncontrolled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when a folder opens or closes.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when a row is activated: Enter, or a double click while selecting.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Tree.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifies the row in selectedKeys and expandedKeys.

props.name: title
props.description: The name shown on the row. Its extension picks the file icon.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text for typeahead and the accessible name. Defaults to title when it is a string.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the folder or file icon.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested TreeItem elements. Having children makes the row a folder, which opens when its row is clicked.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: The row cannot be selected or opened.
